questions.stem: Why are evolutionary trees (phylogenetic trees) useful in biology?

options.text: They show the number of individuals in each species
They show the physical size of each organism
They show the habitat of each organism
They show how closely related different species are and their common ancestors

questions.explanation: Evolutionary trees show the evolutionary relationships between organisms. Species that share a recent common ancestor are shown as closely branching, while more distantly related species branch further apart.
